    MPOW LED Bone Conduction Bluetooth Headphones Earphones 32GB Swimming Waterproof

    MPOW Bluetooth Bone Conduction Swimming Headphones IPX8 Waterproof Open Ear Earbuds LED Light Bone-Air Conduction Dual Driver Deep Bass, Underwater MP3 Mode 32GB Memory, 10H Playtime, Bluetooth 6.0 Ear buds Rear LED safety Light for Sports 

     

    Note:

    1. The earphones cannot be soaked in seawater/salt water for a long time. After use, they should be rinsed with fresh water and dried.The charging magnetic part is easy to corrode.
    2. If it is not used for a long time, please fully charge it at least once a month.

     

    Special Note for Swimming Use:
    Before swimming, please disable Bluetooth mode. These waterproof bone conduction headphones can only be used underwater in MP3 mode. Ensure the built-in MP3 files are pre-loaded, as Bluetooth signals cannot transmit underwater. Using Bluetooth mode underwater may cause damage to your headphones.

     

    Features:

    1. Multi-Color Rear Safety LED Light: Built-in rear LED safety light strip comes with 6 light colors and 2 light modes to enhance your visibility in low-light conditions. Enhances visibility for early-morning walks, evening runs, bike rides, dog walks and outdoor workouts. A subtle safety-focused feature, not a flashy decoration.

    2. MP3 Mode & Bluetooth 6.0: The bone conduction headphones come with a built-in 32GB memory card to store up to 8,000 songs for phone-free listening in and out of the water. Besides, the waterproof headphones feature Bluetooth 6.0 technology to ensure an ultra-low transmission latency which significantly enhances the music experience. This is the solution for runners and athletes who want to leave their phone behind. 

    3. IPX8 Waterproof Design: Designed specifically for swimming, bone conduction headphones feature IPX8 waterproof performance and a triple-seal design, allowing immersion in water up to 2 meters deep for 2 hours. Enjoy uninterrupted music or podcasts even 
    underwater—making them the perfect companion for swimming, rowing, or surfing training (Note: Triple-click the power button to switch to MP3 mode before entering the water; Bluetooth mode cannot connect underwater.)

    4. Comfortable Open-Ear Design: The open-ear bone conduction design lets you enjoy music while staying fully aware of your surroundings. The skin-friendly, soft silicone pads on the earcups provide a comfortable and snug fit. The open design promotes air circulation, ensuring all-day comfort even during extended wear. 

    5. Long Battery Life & Magnetic Charging: Enjoy up to 10 hours of continuous playback on a single charge. The magnetic charging design enables fast and hassle-free charging. Durable and ergonomically crafted, these waterproof headphones are built for long training sessions and an active lifestyle.
